This vertical editorial illustration features a central caricature of a man against a white background with red borders. The man, depicted with an enlarged head and small body, is seated in mid-air with no visible chair. He has dark hair, a prominent nose, and closed eyes. He wears a light grey, long-sleeved button-up shirt and dark trousers. His right hand points a finger toward his chest, while his left hand rests on his thigh. On his feet are tan, foam-clog shoes.

Above the man is the large red word “TEMPO” in a serif font. Smaller black text above this reads “PENYULUT RUSUH WAMENA / OTAK DI BALIK MOLOTOV AKSI 212”. Below the main title, red block letters state “ENAK DIBACA DAN”. To the left of the figure, bold black text reads “PERPU, TIDAK, PERPU, TIDAK…”. Smaller text below this states “JOKOWI TAK KUNJUNG MENGAMBIL KEPUTUSAN PERIHAL PEMBATALAN REVISI UNDANG-UNDANG KPK. TERSEBAB INFORMASI PALSU KOMISI MENYADAP PEJABAT ISTANA?”. In the bottom left corner is a barcode, date “7-13 OKTOBER 2019”, price “RP 45.000”, and other publishing details.
